contexts.text: It is otherwise with those who have been born... as queens, etc... These, although they have lived in luxury, splendour, and elegance, provided they have lived in faith... and charity... are among the happy.
The coming of the queen of Sheba to Solomon. Explained. AC 10199:7.
The queen () = the Church as the Lord's wife.
I sit a queen () = that they will dominate perpetually. ( = Heaven and the Church under their dominion. AE 1120.)
The bride was clad in a state mantle, like a queen, and wore a crown on her head; because (on that day only) she represented the Church.
They teach that their faith is like a queen...
This (true) faith is with us like a queen...
The Siren effused the idea of herself as of a queen sitting on a throne... SE 4459.

The queen standing at his right hand in best gold of Ophir () = the Lord's Celestial I Kingdom which is in the good of love. ( = Heaven and the Church, and those there who are in truths from good... AE 298:7. AE 684:18. AE 863:14. AE 1120:2.)
When the Lord is called a King, then by a queen is meant Heaven and the Church.
